admins.title: SSO Admins
admins.description: Everyone currently granted Super Admin or Admin access to this panel.

secretModal.title: Client Secret
secretModal.body: Copy this secret now and store it securely — it will not be shown again. If you lose it, you'll need to revoke this client and register a new one.
secretModal.logoutSecretBody: Copy this logout webhook signing secret now and share it with the client app's team — it will not be shown again. They'll need it to verify the X-SSO-Signature header on incoming logout notifications.

modal.logoutUriHelp: Optional. If set, this app is notified whenever an admin revokes a user's access, so it can end its own local session immediately.
modal.grantTypeHelp: Use Implicit only for legacy consumers that require it (e.g. Odoo's built-in OAuth login). It always issues tokens without a client secret. This cannot be changed after the client is created.
modal.publicClientHelp: No client secret is issued — the app must use PKCE. Leave unchecked for server-side apps (web dashboards, backends), which get a secret to keep confidential. This cannot be changed after the client is created.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Users can belong to any number of groups. Groups can also be used to restrict which users are allowed to authenticate with a given OAuth client.

families.title: Families
families.description: Group registered users into families so you can see who a student's father or mother is at a glance.
families.confirmDelete: Delete this family? Members will not be deleted, only unlinked.
families.confirmRequireDataUpdateAll: Require every user in every family to update their data before they can sign in to any other app?
